sources.notes: Official site confirms Desert Fleet Outfitters, LLC at 4635 S 33rd Street in Phoenix, phone 480-295-1676, orders@dfofilters.com, Monday-Friday 7:00 AM-4:00 PM, and 24/7 service available. It describes DFO as a full-service supplier for heavy-equipment maintenance products and customized filter service kits.
